deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 46% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 36% last year; 31%/yr over 3 years — the market expects faster growth than the company has recently delivered.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity -16% (3 years ago -29%). (Tax rate estimated at 21%: effective rate not reported.)

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $2.9B, up 34% from a year ago — about 1.1× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $916M, up 42% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Stock-based pay is 21% of sales — a real cost to shareholders that cash-flow figures leave out.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 31%/yr over 3 years and 36%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today -14% vs a 5-year range of -21–-9% (median -14%): in the middle of its range.
deeper.margin_position: in the middle of its range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 2.2% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.85, up 11% in 90 days (up 10% in the last 30); 2 analysts raised, 1 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.35, up 8% in 90 days (up 7% in the last 30); 1 analyst raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.text: By region, latest quarter vs a year earlier: US 52% of sales, up 44%; Europe, Middle East, and Africa 26% of sales, up 32%; Asia Pacific 14% of sales, up 32%; Other 8% of sales, up 46%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.
